assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two reviewed items curated on tomozaki:natsubayashi-hanabi@light-novel at basis_commit, each read in full: #provisional-character-study, the canonical Natsubayashi Hanabi (Tama) character monograph (generation V12_REVIEWED_TAMA, maturity MATURE_LOCAL_LITERARY_ROLE, accepted scope A, independent review pass 2026-10-23) over the audited Japanese main V01-V11, the admitted V12 witness and story-locally routed V06.5/V08.5, whose register TH-P01 to TH-P08 gives targeted primary windows for V05, V06, V06.5, V08, V08.5, the V05 appended bonus and V12, while V01-V04 and V09-V11 are retained through routed readings and ledgers that were not newly reread; and #bounded-reconstruction-model, the canonical derived-use model with root construction admission MR-P05 (model core V1), marked do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority, which derives from that monograph and is not used as literary evidence. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. The V12/principal and R06 integration review, the principal B model integration review and evidence packet, the readings, ledgers, voice ledger, Mimimi-Tama specialist synthesis and full-series synthesis to which these items route are not curated on this subject and are not evidence here. Much of Tama's conduct is filtered through Fumiya, and V08.5 is narrated privately by Mimimi. No adaptation, performed voice, reception or post-V12 material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eleven selectors: TH-S1 earlier ordinary company and the V05 appended bonus (diegetic date unknown), TH-S2 V04-V05 harassment, TH-S3 V05 copied and revised training, TH-S4 V05 reversed crowd and apology, TH-S5 V06 selected participation and teaching, TH-S6 V07 structured acting, TH-S7 V08 family craft, TH-S8 V08.5 year-end privacy (story-local, between V07 and V08), TH-S9 V12 practiced service, TH-S10 V12 cake decision and TH-S11 V12 addressed retrospective account, with the monograph's V01-V12 chronology as context. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph's thesis, a learned commitment made answerable through practice with uneven freedom over its application (sections 2, 5-7 and 15), is tested against rival readings (sections 12 and 15.5) and operationalized as model mechanisms TM1-TM6, which keep conviction, method, skill, authority and ethical sufficiency as separate variables. B is rejected because the V11 state vector gives self-concept only medium confidence, section 15.6 names the decisive open tests (a hostile-recipient retest, revising a self-defining end rather than its delivery, a work disagreement under less family privilege, a negotiated distribution of cost), and the model restricts self-binding and outward cost to restricted fields. D is rejected because a reviewed A-scope monograph with tested rivals exceeds distributed evidence.

The section 3 chronology gives a band for each volume V01-V12 with an analytical limit, section 4 preserves the V11 state vector and section 15.4 adds a V12 overlay, and the model's eleven selectors each name a transfer limit. B is rejected because V09-V11 supply no new developmental event, V01-V04 and V09-V11 are retained claims that were not newly reread (sections 1 and 16), and the change from the V08 craft trial to the V12 self-account rests on one V12 window with V10 only routed. D is rejected because the stated states and transfer controls are explicit and primary-located for V05-V08.5 and V12.

Section 9.3 and model section 3 locate recipient-specific communicative acts: correcting and teasing Mimimi, direct thanks to Fumiya with a demand that the thanks be received (V06 part0022 P164-228), protest at parents' affectionate exposure (V08 part0024 P32-81), service politeness, explanation and a wait apology to customers (V12 p-0014 P30-76) and plain self-critical explanation after work. C is rejected because the curated items quote no speech, section 9.3 says none of these samples is a complete idiolect, the discovery row claims no speech or register, and the model generates no freeform Japanese. E is rejected because register contrast across recipients is located with primary windows.

Ordinary behavior is directly evidenced: in the V05 appended bonus Tama asks the café to omit shrimp for Mimimi, orders risotto, leaves for an ordinary reason and enjoys Mimimi's appetite (part0034 P10-31, part0036 P1-39); in the V06.5 outing she finds a repeated gag boring and refuses karaoke before joining a restaurant (part0033 P10-65); V08 shows liked shop work and holiday baking practice (part0020 P267-307, part0022 P110-159). B is rejected because section 9.4 establishes no food, fashion or music profile, schedule or household routine, and section 9.2 corrects the inference from childhood objects. D is rejected because several primary windows show her own ordinary choices.

Section 8 gives distinct, located conduct and limits per recipient: Mimimi (bonus, V08.5 part0021 P80-105/P127-189), Fumiya as learner and teacher (V06), Mizusawa as an unfamiliar recipient (V05 part0012 P149-204), Akiyama and the group apology (V05 part0028 P1-35), parents and the grandfather as quality judge (V08) and the V12 customer and colleague; model section 3 operationalizes these differences. A is rejected because the Hinami dyad is described largely from Hinami's side with no processed Tama response, Tama gives no reply to Mimimi's V12 separation fear, and the post-V05 Konno relation is undeveloped. C is rejected because the variation is explicit and primary-located across many recipients.

Section 10 states that Tama is often described from outside and does not supply explanatory monologues, and section 15.5 acknowledges the absence of extensive private interiority in many mainline scenes; the strongest window is the V12 self-account (p-0014 P109-141), which the monograph classifies as addressed, co-produced speech rather than private introspection, with the V06 stated reduced strain as a smaller instance. C is rejected because no direct internal focalization of Tama is located and V08.5 is narrated by Mimimi. E is rejected because direct self-report of an experienced limit (later disliking herself) and of a borrowed ideal becoming owned is located.

Conflict behavior is located across distinct modes: immediate objection to unannounced recording followed by later participation (V05), stopping the collective attack on Konno and receiving Akiyama's apology weightily (part0028 P1-35), questioning an unfamiliar recipient associated with teasing (part0012 P149-204), and overriding a colleague's quick-repair proposal (V12 p-0014 P46-76); TM2 and TM6 bound these. B is rejected because no hostile-recipient retest occurs after V05, the model excludes predicting a new severe hostile result, and a work disagreement without family latitude is an open test. D is rejected because several modes rest on primary windows.

Tama's own moral reasoning is shown: collective attack is wrong even against a wrongdoer (V05), condemning an act is separated from joining punishment, and in V12 she agrees there may have been a cleverer way, admits distortion and acknowledges that being the shop manager's daughter made her insistence possible (p-0014 P119-141). B is rejected because the principle is shown more in act than in deliberation, the cost-distribution value judgment in section 15.2 is the monograph's own and labeled conditional, and the model returns only competing reasons and a range for a new quality or cost choice. D is rejected because her explicit principle and self-critique are located.

Play is located: teaching Fumiya an exaggerated comic face and handling capture and upload consent separately (V06 part0022 P164-228), finding a repeated smallness gag boring and revising a comic opening (V06.5 part0033 P10-65), private laughter at Mimimi's appetite (bonus) and the V12 'defeating Konno' image that makes Fumiya laugh. C is rejected because no humor style is analysed and the samples are scattered local acts. E is rejected because several are located primary windows of her own play.

The monograph is an independently reviewed A-scope account through V12 with targeted primary returns for V05, V06, V06.5, V08, V08.5, the appended bonus and V12. B is rejected because sections 1 and 16 state that V01-V04 and V09-V11 were retained through routed readings and ledgers rather than newly reread, the full-series synthesis it routes to is a pre-remediation hypothesis inventory, and relationship, convergence and release gates remain separate. D is rejected because a reviewed mature monograph with primary windows across its central bands exceeds distributed evidence.

Affirmative limits and corrections are located: Akiyama and the group apologize while Konno's apology is absent (V05 part0028 P1-35); the room's pastel objects are retained childhood gifts, not current taste (V08); risotto is one order; capture assent and upload assent are separate (V06); the initial recording lacked advance permission; the V12 customer first releases the shop and later thanks it, while staff, queue and Fumiya absorb cost and Tama names her family latitude (p-0014 P46-141); Tama wanted to flee after the keepsake was destroyed. A is rejected because succession, a reply to Mimimi and any hostile retest are evidence gaps, not affirmative evidence, and several limits rest on one scene. C is rejected because the limits are explicit, primary-located and corrected against countercases.

Each selector binds era and actor knowledge: the bonus date is marked unknown, V08.5 keeps its year-end story-local clock and its private exchange is not Fumiya's knowledge, the V05 apology sequence is fixed in order, and Mimimi's V12 interview is excluded from Tama's knowledge because she is absent. A is rejected because V09-V11 have no selector and the V10 first original cake is only routed. C is rejected because era and knowledge controls are explicit for every selector.

scenario_readiness.note: The model generates no freeform Japanese and produces no full idiolect; the curated items quote no Tama speech, section 9.3 says the recipient samples are not a complete idiolect, and the discovery row claims no speech or register. scenario_readiness.note: The model supports bounded familiar alternatives (TM3, moderate), a concrete check, explanation or consultation for a new modest shop task within known standing (TM5) and conditional competing reasons for a costly quality disagreement (TM6, restricted). NOT_READY is rejected because bounded novel acts inside the admitted fields are explicitly supported with stated confidence.

Tama's anti-collective-cruelty principle and V12 self-critique are located, but the model returns only competing reasons and a conditional range for a new quality or cost choice, excludes predicting a new severe hostile outcome, and the monograph leaves the revision of a self-defining end and any negotiated cost distribution as open tests. known_limits.statement: In V05 Akiyama and other group members apologize to Tama after Konno leaves; Konno's own apology, Tama's forgiveness of Konno, restitution and completed justice are not shown.
Fumiya records Tama's training without advance permission; her immediate objection and later participation are separate facts, and later participation does not rewrite the permission state.
In V06 Tama's agreement to an image capture and her agreement to its upload are separate acts; one is not a standing grant for the other.
The pastel possessions and stuffed toys in Tama's room are largely retained childhood gifts, not her current taste; the risotto is one observed order and the bracelet one observed use.

In V08 Tama likes the shop's products and work but intends to learn through experience before deciding succession, and alternative relatives or trusted employees are explicitly possible; V10 and V12 do not elect a career.

The V12 remake benefits the child's celebration and earns the mother's thanks, while a quick repair was a real alternative and staff, queued customers and Fumiya absorb its cost; Tama acknowledges that her standing as the shop manager's daughter made the insistence possible, and the acknowledgment does not redistribute the labor.

Tama's V12 statement that letting such a case go lightly could make her dislike herself is addressed self-report of an experienced limit, not a clinical diagnosis or proof she never compromises; the V06 choice not to join every act, the V08 conditional succession and the V08.5 waiting are counterexamples to universal rigidity.
Mimimi's V12 fear about keeping her self-regard after separation is Mimimi's own account given while Tama is absent; no Tama answer or standing promise is supplied.
Tama wanted to flee after her keepsake was destroyed, and the V05 stopping intervention depended on a support network and changed reception as well as her judgment.
No hostile-recipient retest, revision of a self-defining end, work disagreement under less family privilege or negotiated cost distribution is shown after V05.
V01-V04 and V09-V11 are retained through routed readings and ledgers that are not curated on this subject and were not newly reread for the monograph; V09-V11 carry no new developmental event.
Prices, staff contracts, a standing remake protocol, wages, schedules and the shop's employee hierarchy are not established.
No idiolect, particle or honorific profile, pitch or performed voice is established; no freeform Japanese or blind accuracy is validated.
Nothing after the V12 boundary, and no career, adult, household, romantic or clinical domain, is evidenced.
